ch4.intro_prose: Intuitive Surgical closed at $399.05 on November 20, 2026, dropping 10.04% for the week and breaching our prior $401.77 structural stop. Here we reconcile the Stage 4 snapshot breakdown against the market-facts Stage 1 basing tag using live weekly, daily, and 4-hour levels.
ch4.gate_intro_prose: Even when a company earns COMPOUNDER_PASS on business quality, our technical ceiling forbids buying or accumulating during a Stage 4 breakdown below the 30-week average.
ch4.closing_prose: Waiting for a true Stage 1 base and Stage 2 breakout protects capital while the 200-day average ($427.69) slopes downward and the S&P 500 trades in a 10-distribution-day Downtrend.
ch4.tech_table_takeaway: ISRG trades below its 30-week SMA ($406.23), 10-week EMA ($420.05), 50-day SMA ($423.51), and declining 200-day SMA ($427.69) on 1.07x 30-day volume, confirming Stage 4 momentum damage despite a conflicting Stage 1 tag in the facts ledger.
ch4.gate_table_takeaway: Because ISRG sits in Stage 4 (CAP_REJECTED) and realistic Pivot S2 support ($345.25–$356.90) versus a $325.00 stop yields only 0.57:1 asymmetry to our $375.00 Base Fair Value, new capital is REJECTED.
ch4.stage_explanation: Snapshot flags STAGE_4 below 30W SMA ($406.23) and 50D SMA ($423.51); market-facts ledger still tags Stage 1 (Basing) on rising 50D SMA vs 21d ago. We enforce the stricter STAGE_4 ceiling.

ch4.stop_placement_explanation: Monitor-only structural reference ($325.00) sits 2.21x ATR ($14.43) below $356.90 and beneath the $328.57 52-week low; not an active order because ISRG is REJECTED and NOT_HELD.

Shares fell 10.04% weekly to $399.05 on November 20, 2026, breaking our $401.77 stop into Stage 4 amid Hugo and OTTAVA competition. After $835.3M stock-based pay and the $450.0M antitrust accrual, normalized ex-SBC FCF is $2,313.2M (59.8x P/FCF) versus $375.00 Base Fair Value. With zero shares held and Pivot S2 support failing 1.50:1 asymmetry, we assign REJECTED (TIER_0; VALUATION, TREND) and hold 100% cash.
